_about: Requirement source of each human-confirmed failure (the 40 items of analysis/human_taxonomy.json): where the requirement that the item fails is stated. Display and analysis only: no verdict, adjudication or failure type changes. Tagged after the runs from the task prompts (formal task inputs) and the adjudication evidence. 'prompt_fragments' are verbatim substrings of the task prompt; site/build.py checks them.
status_note: Proposed by Claude on 2026-11-03 at the author's request; approved by the author on 2026-11-03, including each of the twelve judgment calls (items marked debatable, each with its own author_decision).

rule.prompt: The prompt itself asks for the missing element (a level, measure, tab, section or statement), so a reader of the prompt alone would expect it.
rule.rubric: The prompt leaves the element open: the rubric fixes its exact wording, form or detail, or adds it beyond the prompt. Where the deliverable covers what the prompt names in another form, the item is rubric.
rule.rule: The item fails only under a rule this evaluation added before the runs (the pre-registered additions rule).
